answer_1.quote: We selected four datasets from different tasks: MT-Bench  for multi-turn dialogue, GSM8k  for mathematical reasoning, CNN/DM  for abstractive summarization, and HumanEval  for code generation.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs across multiple natural language generation tasks including dialogue, summarization, and code generation.

answer_2.quote: We use three metrics to assess the acceleration effect of different methods: (1) Walltime speedup: The actual speedup ratio relative to autoregressive decoding... (2) Acceptance rate α: The average acceptance ratio of draft tokens... (3) Average acceptance length τ : The average number of new tokens generated in each iteration.
